family_observation: The 2005 and 2010 Foothills trailhead maps share a regional base but use different local insets. The 2006 regional Foothills sheet and 2018 overview are dated versions. The other property maps supply separate site boundaries and access detail; the two City HTML pages are source context alongside archived maps.
dated_use_limit: The older maps are preserved as dated historical references. Trail alignments, access and restrictions require the maintained City Open Space map library and onsite information for current use.

record_observations.title: Foothills Trail Map: Indian School
record_observations.visual_observation: The 2005 Foothills base includes a blue-bordered Indian School inset, numbered trails, parking and the Wilderness bicycle restriction.
record_observations.distinct_public_use: The inset makes the Indian School access network legible at a scale the regional Foothills sheet cannot provide.

record_observations.title: Foothills Trail Map: Piedra Lisa
record_observations.visual_observation: The 2005 Foothills base includes a distinct Piedra Lisa inset with its loop, contour detail, access and the Wilderness bicycle restriction.
record_observations.distinct_public_use: The Piedra Lisa loop and access detail differ from the Indian School and Embudito insets even though their regional base is shared.

record_observations.title: John A. Milne/Gutierrez Canyon Open Space Trail Map
record_observations.visual_observation: The aerial property map shows a bounded trail network, two parking locations, NM 14 approach, route mileage and surrounding private property.
record_observations.distinct_public_use: It connects the City's East Mountain Open Space holding to public trail access and the property boundary around Gutierrez Canyon.

record_observations.title: Foothills Trail Map: Embudito
record_observations.visual_observation: The 2005 Foothills base includes an Embudito inset with a trailhead, numbered paths, contours, access and nearby Forest Service land.
record_observations.distinct_public_use: The Embudito route detail is a distinct trailhead reference within the otherwise shared historical Foothills base.

record_observations.title: City of Albuquerque Open Space Overview Map
record_observations.visual_observation: The system overview indexes 46 numbered City Open Space locations across the West Mesa, Bosque, Sandia Foothills and East Mountain areas, with land ownership and a scale legend.
record_observations.distinct_public_use: It provides one geographic index linking the City's dispersed Open Space holdings and neighboring public lands, beyond any single trail map.

record_observations.title: Placitas Open Space Trail Map
record_observations.visual_observation: The Placitas aerial map labels official trails, Las Huertas Creek, access gates, parking, distance scale, private property and driving directions from Albuquerque.
record_observations.distinct_public_use: It identifies the City Open Space property's public access and neighboring ownership limits in Sandoval County.

record_observations.title: Manzano/Four Hills Open Space Trail Map
record_observations.visual_observation: The Manzano/Four Hills aerial sheet traces official loops, multiple access points, surrounding housing and Tijeras Arroyo beside southeast Albuquerque.
record_observations.distinct_public_use: It gives local path geometry and access points that are absent from the citywide Open Space overview.

record_observations.title: Foothills Trail Map: Copper
record_observations.visual_observation: The 2010 Foothills sheet adds a blue-bordered Copper Avenue inset and a bike path connection near I-40, with numbered routes and parking.
record_observations.distinct_public_use: The Copper access and bike path relationship differ from other trailhead insets; its revision date supports historical comparison.

record_observations.title: Paseo de la Mesa Recreation Trail Map
record_observations.visual_observation: The West Mesa aerial map identifies the 4.2-mile Paseo de la Mesa route, two parking points, Petroglyph National Monument boundaries and volcanic windows.
record_observations.distinct_public_use: It relates a paved recreation corridor to public land boundaries and access across Albuquerque's Northwest Mesa.

record_observations.title: San Antonito Open Space Trail Map
record_observations.visual_observation: The San Antonito aerial map shows the short official trail network, two access points, private land and 20-foot contour intervals.
record_observations.distinct_public_use: It identifies safe public access and property limits for a City Open Space holding outside central Albuquerque.

record_observations.title: Elena Gallegos Open Space Trail Map
record_observations.visual_observation: The Elena Gallegos map differentiates hiker-only and multi-use routes, the fee area, parking, amphitheater, facilities and Wilderness bicycle limits.
record_observations.distinct_public_use: The facility and route restrictions make this site-specific reference distinct from a systemwide Foothills map.

record_observations.title: Official source: Sandia Foothills Open Space Trail Map
record_observations.visual_observation: The City Open Space Maps page groups trail, facility and other maps, including the 2018 Foothills map and dated links to multiple individual property maps.
record_observations.distinct_public_use: As the maintained source library beside archived PDFs, it supplies official collection context and a path to later City revisions.

record_observations.title: Los Poblanos Fields Open Space Trail Map
record_observations.visual_observation: The Los Poblanos aerial sheet shows the Open Space trail, access points, parking, fields, the Rio Grande Community Farm and nearby drains.
record_observations.distinct_public_use: It connects City Open Space access to agricultural land and Bosque-side facilities in Albuquerque.

record_observations.title: Official source: Paseo de la Mesa Recreation Trail Map
record_observations.visual_observation: The City Paseo de la Mesa page describes 4.2 miles of paved trail, advanced rider and hiker use, access from Unser and Molten Rock, and a linked map.
record_observations.distinct_public_use: It supplies trail-use and access context beside the preserved 2018 aerial map without pretending to be another static map.

record_observations.title: Foothills Open Space Trail Map
record_observations.visual_observation: The 2018 Foothills overview maps official trails, paved multi-use links, trailheads, facilities, City land and Forest Service Wilderness restrictions on one regional sheet.
record_observations.distinct_public_use: It is the newer system reference that explains how the individual older trailhead insets connect across the Albuquerque Foothills.

record_observations.title: Foothills Trail Map: Menaul
record_observations.visual_observation: The 2010 Foothills sheet adds a blue-bordered Menaul inset with numbered routes, streets, parking and nearby Wilderness restrictions.
record_observations.distinct_public_use: The Menaul entrance and local route geometry give this dated inset a distinct use within the Foothills series.

record_observations.title: Golden Open Space Trail Map
record_observations.visual_observation: The Golden aerial sheet maps two loop areas, a scenic overlook, road access, parking, contours, private property and state land without public access.
record_observations.distinct_public_use: It distinguishes City Open Space trails from surrounding restricted land in the East Mountain area.

record_observations.title: Sandia Foothills Open Space Trail Map
record_observations.visual_observation: The 2006 Foothills map covers Elena Gallegos, Bear Canyon, Embudito and Copper with numbered routes, trailheads and Wilderness boundaries.
record_observations.distinct_public_use: It preserves the earlier network layout for comparison with the separately archived 2018 Foothills overview.
